scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with coherent CSS-variable theming, consistent blue accent, uppercase panel labels with letter-spacing, and quiet muted axis text — all show clear design intentionality, though the dense multi-panel layout at rendered size makes the network labels and thumbnail grid feel slightly cramped.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: All area encodings use scaleSqrt, bar baseline starts at zero, domains are data-driven (d3.extent/d3.max), binning uses semantic utcMonth thresholds — minor inconsistency in network rScale domain (d3.extent vs [0,max] in filtered mode) but no lie factor or baseline violations.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag RAF pattern correctly coalesces renders, but bitFilter.set() iterates ~34k blocks synchronously on every brush mousemove without debouncing; all other checks pass — no infinite loops, no D3 transitions to interrupt, and pointer events sidestep mouse/touch fights.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views with crossfilter are coherent and the restrained two-tone palette works well, but the 60-node force network is visibly dense in the screenshot and the thumbnail wall produces visual noise that competes with the analytic panels above it.

proposer: Consolidated the `#reset-btn` and `#theme-btn` CSS into a shared `.header-controls button` rule, eliminating 12 lines of duplicated properties (font-family, border, border-radius, background, color, cursor, and hover state).
